_comment: Single source of truth for ALL network ports across backend (Python), frontend (Vite/TS) and desktop (Tauri/Rust). Edit here only; the three runtimes read this file. See docs/80-operations/dev-environment.md.

_notes.backend: Server bind port. PINNED by the Okta SSO redirect_uri http://localhost:8989/callback registered on the authorization server. A SECOND redirect_uri http://localhost:28688/callback is ALSO registered as the SSO-approved fallback — see ``fallbacks`` below. Any port outside ``fallbacks`` breaks SSO because Okta rejects unregistered redirect_uris.
_notes.dev_backend_proxy: Dev-only Vite proxy target — the bare uvicorn debug backend developers run alongside the 5173 dev server.
_notes.legacy_packaged: Legacy packaged default; kept for CORS backward-compat and as the first supervisor fallback candidate.
_notes.fallbacks: apps/cli/serve.py FALLBACK_PORTS — probed in order when --port is omitted (Windows excluded-port-range resilience). BOTH entries MUST be Okta-registered redirect_uris (currently 8989 primary + 28688 secondary). Do NOT add a port here without registering the matching http://localhost:<port>/callback on the Okta side — every login on the unregistered port would fail with redirect_uri mismatch.
_notes.cors_extra_origins: Extra ports (besides backend) whose http://127.0.0.1:<port> and http://localhost:<port> origins are added to the CORS allow-list.
